templates.name: Ransomware that stops contact center operations
templates.description: An attack encrypts servers and workstations and stops customer service and collections.
templates.causes: Phishing of agents; outdated patches; remote access without MFA; backups reachable from the network.
templates.consequences: Service interruption; SLA breaches and penalties; data loss or exposure; recovery costs; reputational damage.
templates.controls: EDR on every device; MFA on remote access; immutable and tested backups; network segmentation; anti-phishing training.
templates.kris: % of devices with active EDR; critical patches pending > 30 days; result of the last restore test.

templates.name: Prolonged outage of the telephony or omnichannel platform
templates.description: The contact center platform (voice, chat, messaging) is down for hours.
templates.causes: Single provider without redundancy; untested changes; connectivity or power failure.
templates.consequences: Lost calls and contacts; SLA breaches with clients; contractual penalties; complaints.
templates.controls: Contract with SLA and credits; alternative link and site; tested continuity plan; change management.
templates.kris: Monthly platform availability; minutes of downtime; recovery time in the last plan test.

templates.name: Leak of personal data of our clients' customers
templates.description: Data of debtors or end users (IDs, debts, call recordings) is exposed or obtained by third parties.
templates.causes: Excessive access rights; uncontrolled exports; unencrypted recordings; suppliers without controls.
templates.consequences: Breach of data protection law; complaints to the regulator; loss of financial clients; reputational damage.
templates.controls: Role-based access and periodic review; DLP; encrypted recordings; confidentiality clauses; access logging.
templates.kris: Privileged accesses reviewed in the quarter; DLP alerts; personal data incidents.

templates.name: Failure or exit of a critical technology provider
templates.description: A cloud, CRM or telephony provider stops the service or changes conditions.
templates.causes: Dependence on a single provider; contracts without exit clauses; no supplier monitoring.
templates.consequences: Service interruption; urgent migration costs; breaches with clients.
templates.controls: Annual assessment of critical suppliers; continuity and exit clauses; exit plan; SLA monitoring.
templates.kris: Critical suppliers without a current assessment; supplier SLA breaches.

templates.name: Unavailability of the operations site
templates.description: The building is inaccessible or without power or connectivity (outage, flood, strike).
templates.causes: Single site; no generator or alternative link; dependence on on-site work.
templates.consequences: Agents unable to work; service level drop; penalties.
templates.controls: Remote work enabled and tested; generator and UPS; redundant links; continuity plan.
templates.kris: % of agents enabled for remote work; result of the last drill.

templates.name: High agent turnover and absenteeism
templates.description: Turnover or absenteeism exceed the plan and the required staffing is not covered.
templates.causes: Working conditions; demand peaks; insufficient training; competitive labour market.
templates.consequences: Service level drop; SLA breaches; recruitment and training costs.
templates.controls: Workforce planning (WFM); retention plan; initial and ongoing training; replacement pool.
templates.kris: Monthly agent turnover; absenteeism; service level per campaign.

templates.name: Dependence on key people
templates.description: Critical knowledge (systems, clients, processes) concentrated in a few people.
templates.causes: Lack of documentation; no trained backups; middle management turnover.
templates.consequences: Delays or errors when that person is absent; loss of knowledge.
templates.controls: Process documentation; designated and trained backups; job rotation.
templates.kris: Critical processes without a designated backup.

templates.name: Wrong information given to end users
templates.description: Agents or bots give wrong amounts, deadlines or conditions.
templates.causes: Outdated scripts; outdated customer data; no quality control.
templates.consequences: Complaints; rework; consumer protection sanctions; loss of client trust.
templates.controls: Quality monitoring of interactions; scripts approved by the client; data taken online from the client's system.
templates.kris: % of interactions with errors in quality monitoring; complaints about wrong information.

templates.name: Breach of contracted service levels
templates.description: Service level, handling time or quality fall below what was agreed with the client.
templates.causes: Wrong demand forecast; insufficient staffing; technology failures.
templates.consequences: Penalties; loss of contracts; damage to the business relationship.
templates.controls: Capacity management; real-time alerts; daily KPI follow-up with the client.
templates.kris: Daily service level; penalties of the month.

templates.name: Breach of personal data protection regulations
templates.description: Processing of personal data does not comply with the applicable data protection law and regulator rules.
templates.causes: Unregistered databases; no consent or purpose; data subject rights not answered on time.
templates.consequences: Regulator sanctions; complaints of data subjects; requirements of financial clients.
templates.controls: Record of processing activities; data subject rights procedure; supplier assessment; training.
templates.kris: Data subject requests answered late; databases without current registration.

templates.name: Collection practices contrary to consumer protection rules
templates.description: Collection uses abusive practices: hours, frequency, pressure or disclosure to third parties.
templates.causes: Aggressive targets; no control of scripts and hours; automation without limits.
templates.consequences: Complaints and sanctions; lawsuits; loss of the financial client; reputational damage.
templates.controls: Collection code; automatic limits on hours and frequency; call monitoring; training.
templates.kris: Complaints about collection practices; out-of-hours contacts detected.

templates.name: Breach of contractual and regulatory requirements of financial clients
templates.description: We do not meet the security, continuity or audit requirements that banks and lenders pass on to their suppliers.
templates.causes: Requirements not identified; scattered evidence; unprepared client audits.
templates.consequences: Audit findings; penalties; contract termination or non-renewal.
templates.controls: Requirements matrix per client; centralised evidence; prior internal audits; compliance owner per account.
templates.kris: Open findings of client audits; requirements without evidence.

templates.name: Misuse of data or fraud by agents
templates.description: An agent uses customer data for personal or third-party purposes, or diverts payments.
templates.causes: Broad access; no monitoring; financial pressure; no segregation of duties.
templates.consequences: Losses; lawsuits; breach of confidentiality; loss of the client.
templates.controls: Least privilege; data masking; recording and monitoring; payment controls; whistleblowing channel.
templates.kris: Alerts of anomalous access; reports received.

templates.name: Fraud by social engineering or phone impersonation
templates.description: Third parties impersonate customers or users to obtain data or change information.
templates.causes: Weak identity validation; untrained agents; exception processes.
templates.consequences: Fraud against end users; client complaints; reputational damage.
templates.controls: Multi-factor identity validation; anti-fraud scripts; pattern alerts; training.
templates.kris: Impersonation attempts detected; confirmed fraud cases.

templates.name: Public exposure due to poor service or a leaked recording
templates.description: A case of poor service or a recording goes viral on social networks or media.
templates.causes: Inappropriate treatment; leaked recordings; late response to complaints.
templates.consequences: Damage to our brand and the client's; loss of contracts.
templates.controls: Quality monitoring; crisis and spokesperson protocol; access control to recordings.
templates.kris: Negative mentions on social media; escalated complaints.

templates.name: Revenue concentration in few clients
templates.description: A relevant share of revenue depends on one or two clients.
templates.causes: Concentrated commercial strategy; short-term contracts.
templates.consequences: Sharp revenue drop if a client leaves or reduces volume; idle capacity.
templates.controls: Commercial diversification; longer contracts; satisfaction follow-up of key clients.
templates.kris: % of revenue of the main client; satisfaction index of key clients.

templates.name: Increase of costs in foreign currency
templates.description: Licences, cloud and AI services in foreign currency increase with the exchange rate and are not passed on to prices.
templates.causes: Client contracts in local currency without adjustment; technology costs in foreign currency.
templates.consequences: Margin loss; postponed projects.
templates.controls: Adjustment clauses in contracts; currency hedging; cost follow-up per client.
templates.kris: Margin per client; foreign-currency costs over revenue.

templates.name: Business disruption by AI automation
templates.description: Clients replace human service with their own or competitors' AI agents.
templates.causes: Fast adoption of conversational AI; value proposition based on agent volume.
templates.consequences: Volume and revenue drop; need to reskill staff.
templates.controls: Strategy of own AI services; reskilling of agents; innovation agreements with clients.
templates.kris: % of revenue from AI services; human vs. automated volume.

templates.name: Wrong answers of an AI assistant (hallucinations)
templates.description: The chatbot or voicebot makes up information, amounts or conditions and gives it to the end user.
templates.causes: Unrestricted generative model; information not taken from official sources; no testing.
templates.consequences: Complaints; harm to users; sanctions; loss of client trust.
templates.controls: Answers based only on data of the client's system (RAG); topic limits; hand-over to humans; testing and monitoring of answers.
templates.kris: % of audited answers with errors; hand-overs to humans due to bot errors.

templates.name: Bias or discrimination in AI models
templates.description: A scoring, routing or prioritisation model treats some groups of people worse.
templates.causes: Biased training data; proxy variables (area, age); no fairness testing.
templates.consequences: Discrimination; complaints and sanctions; reputational damage.
templates.controls: Bias testing by segment; human review of adverse decisions; model documentation.
templates.kris: Outcome differences between segments; complaints about unequal treatment.

templates.name: Exposure of personal data to AI providers
templates.description: Agents or systems send customer data to external AI services that store it or use it for training.
templates.causes: Use of unapproved AI tools; contracts without data clauses; no anonymisation.
templates.consequences: Breach of data protection and contracts; loss of clients.
templates.controls: AI usage policy; approved tools with enterprise contract; anonymisation; blocking of unauthorised services.
templates.kris: Use of unauthorised AI tools detected; AI-related data incidents.

templates.name: Manipulation of an AI assistant (prompt injection)
templates.description: A user manipulates the bot to reveal data, bypass controls or act outside its role.
templates.causes: Bot with broad access to data or actions; no guardrails; insufficient security testing.
templates.consequences: Data leak; unauthorised operations; reputational damage.
templates.controls: Least access for the bot; input and output guardrails; periodic security testing (red team); monitoring.
templates.kris: Manipulation attempts detected; open findings of security tests.

templates.name: Lack of transparency when interacting with AI
templates.description: The end user does not know they are talking to an automated system or cannot ask for a person.
templates.causes: Experience designed without notice; no hand-over option.
templates.consequences: Breach of transparency obligations (AI Act art. 50 and client requirements); complaints.
templates.controls: Notice at the start of every interaction; option to talk to a person; interaction logging.
templates.kris: % of interactions with AI notice; requests to talk to a human.

templates.name: Dependence on a single AI model provider
templates.description: AI services depend on one provider or model that can change price, conditions or quality.
templates.causes: Integration tied to one provider; no tested alternatives.
templates.consequences: Service interruption or degradation; cost increase; changes in model behaviour.
templates.controls: Abstraction layer to switch models; periodic evaluation of alternatives; regression testing of new versions.
templates.kris: Cost per interaction; AI provider incidents.

templates.name: Extreme weather events affecting operations
templates.description: Storms, floods or heat waves cut power or connectivity or prevent reaching the site.
templates.causes: Site location; infrastructure without redundancy.
templates.consequences: Service interruption; material damage; risk to staff.
templates.controls: Remote work; power backup; insurance; emergency plan.
templates.kris: Hours of interruption due to weather events.
